scope: Actual installed signed Studio and minimum-built CI ZIP. PID-locked helper activated only real UI controls/actions. Selected owned windows captured and directly visually inspected. No demo report or scanner/guard/provider API injection. No explicit Scan or Start activated; scanOnOpen remained false. Studio performed its ordinary cached Gradle project sync on reopen. Existing inert HTTP server was stopped before this smoke. This check does not establish runtime 262.2/262.3 or physical-device/accessibility acceptance. Normal Exit remained open; after SaveAll the owned PID was terminated, then only owned system indexes were removed.
nextArtifactPolicy: Compare fresh CI ZIP bytes after framework-only changes. Reinstall and repeat this startup/Tools check if bytes differ.

subsequentByteIdenticalArtifact.comparison: Exact SHA-256 identity independently checked against the fresh CI bundle ZIP; no reinstall required for identical bytes.
